title: Pollard: Governed Semantic Execution Trees for Framework-Independent AI Agent Control and Replay
abstract: arXiv:2610.16145v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent frameworks can persist checkpoints, trace tool calls, and limit resource use, but these facilities often assign different identities to execution, governance, and replay. We present Pollard, a framework-independent runtime based on governed semantic execution trees. A step identity commits to canonical input, kind, attempt, and parent identity; the same tree records completion, refusal, resource settlement, and branch history. Strict replay returns a verified stored result without invoking the wrapped operation, while a transactional store coordinates reservations across concurrent workers. Under a signed deterministic freeze, two state-model replicas each executed the evaluation transitions without an invariant violation, retained-lease PostgreSQL groups were tested against exact limits, strict replay avoided external calls, and all semantic mutations were detected with no false alarms on the controls. translated_title: Pollard：基于受治理语义执行树的框架无关AI智能体控制与重放
translated_abstract: 智能体框架虽然能够持久化检查点、追踪工具调用并限制资源使用，但这些机制往往为执行、治理和重放分配不同的身份标识。我们提出了Pollard，一个基于受治理语义执行树的框架无关运行时。其中，步骤身份承诺于规范化输入、类型、尝试次数和父身份；同一棵树记录完成状态、拒绝情况、资源结算和分支历史。严格重放模式无需调用被包装的操作即可返回经过验证的存储结果，同时事务性存储协调并发工作者之间的资源预留。在签名确定性冻结条件下，两个状态模型副本各自执行了评估转换且未发生不变量违规；保留租约的PostgreSQL组通过了精确限制测试；严格重放避免了外部调用；所有语义突变均被检测到，且对照组中无误报。多对框架矩阵（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出了Pollard——一个基于受治理语义执行树的框架无关运行时，通过统一的步骤身份机制将执行、治理与重放整合为一致的可验证控制体系。
en_tdlr: Pollard is a framework-independent runtime built on governed semantic execution trees that unifies execution, governance, and replay under a single verifiable step-identity mechanism.
